g.text: Karman–Trefftz airfoil · 12° finite edge · last 2% of chord
Every curve uses the same stated conformal airfoil and angle. Cp is compared at matching physical points.
Dots are panel-centre predictions, not edge values. The near-edge bends are retained numerical errors, not physical shocks.
Sharp cusp: max |ΔCp| among the last 3 panels = 0.0100 (160) and 0.00587 (320). See the separate signed-error figure.
Source: committed TE_PROFILES.csv and TE_REPAIR_REVIEW.json. No clipping, smoothing, reference replacement or new solver run.
